name: The Westin La Quinta Golf Resort & Spa
insider_take: This championship golf haven sits in the foothills of Sierra de las Nieves, where legendary designer Robert Trent Jones Sr. carved fairways through ancient olive groves just 10 minutes from Marbella's glamorous coastline.
whats_special: The resort's 27-hole championship course is consistently ranked among Spain's top 10, featuring dramatic elevation changes and panoramic views of the Mediterranean. The property occupies a former olive estate, with some trees over 1,000 years old still gracing the grounds. La Quinta was also the filming location for several scenes in James Bond's "Never Say Never Again."
pro_tip: Book tee times for early morning to catch sunrise over the mountains and avoid afternoon winds that sweep up from the coast – plus you'll have the course practically to yourself.
dont_miss: The hotel's wine cellar houses over 3,000 bottles including rare vintages from nearby Ronda region. Take the complimentary shuttle to Puerto Banús marina (Europe's most exclusive yacht harbor) or explore charming Ojén village, birthplace of anise liqueur, nestled in the mountains just 15 minutes away.
pros: Championship Golf On-Site — Direct access to the prestigious La Quinta Golf Course, one of Marbella's finest, makes this a dream destination for golf enthusiasts.
Stunning Mountain & Golf Course Views — Rooms and suites offer breathtaking panoramas of the surrounding Sierra de las Nieves mountains and manicured fairways.
World-Class Spa & Wellness — The expansive Heavenly Spa by Westin delivers an exceptional wellness experience with signature treatments, thermal facilities, and rejuvenating amenities.
Elegant Resort Pools & Family Amenities — Multiple outdoor pools, lush landscaped gardens, and family-friendly facilities provide a complete leisure experience for all guests.
Prime Marbella Location — Nestled in the exclusive Benahavis corridor, guests enjoy easy access to Puerto Banús, Marbella's Golden Mile, and the glamour of the Costa del Sol.
cons: Secluded Hillside Setting — The resort's tranquil, elevated location offers peace and natural beauty, but guests will need a car or taxi to reach Marbella town center and beaches.
Resort-Style Pricing — As a luxury Westin property in one of Spain's most exclusive destinations, dining, spa, and golf services are priced at a premium.
